data.narrative:
Sunday Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $200M to date. The sector comp universe consists of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ), including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using the $200M total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, this method implies a $500M valuation. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum thresholds (only 1 same-stage peer identified in the narrow Robotics & Manufacturing set).

The analysis supports a valuation range of $425M to $575M, with a median of $500M. This range reflects the single applicable method and incorporates conservative and aggressive interpretations of the stage-progression multiplier. Key uncertainties include the composition and performance trajectory of the private peer set, which remains sparse at the Seed stage, and the relevance of the single public comparable to Sunday Robotics' specific business model and market position. Further valuation refinement would benefit from broader market data as the company progresses to later funding rounds.
